test_name: From MusicXML — one include line applies the score defaults
description: The music is musicxml2ly 2.24.2 output (--nd --nrp --npl --no-beaming, Frescobaldi's Import MusicXML defaults) of 21d-Chords-SchubertStabatMater.xml from Reinhold Kainhofer's Unofficial MusicXML test suite (MIT licence), unchanged except for the include lines after \version. It sets neither a magnification nor an indent, so what it gets comes from cnb/score-defaults.ly: every staff magnified by cnb:default-magnify, and a 25 mm first-system indent that leaves room for an instrument name beside the 5 mm left margin of cnb/layout.ly.

assertions.description: The staff is magnified by cnb:default-magnify (7/4): the base engine's staff is 4.0 units tall unmagnified (c-major-scale), so this one is 7.0
The converted score engraves all of its noteheads: f1, then the dyads <f as>4. <f as>8 <g bes>4 <g bes>4

The system's left edge (the staff symbol's) sits at least the 5 mm margin plus the 25 mm indent from the page edge: SVG units are 210 mm / 119.5016 on A4, so 30 mm is 17.07 units. With cnb/layout.ly's indent of 0 it would sit at 2.85 units, and a name would be clipped at the page edge
